map.查询各年龄段死亡率(qx)、存活人数(lx)与预期剩余寿命，简化精算生命表: Query mortality (qx), survivors (lx) and remaining life expectancy by age with a simplified actuarial life table

map.由需求与保费变动率求弹性: Elasticity from demand and premium change rates
map.lx 和 qx 哪来？: Where do lx and qx come from?
map.来自经验生命表或行业表(如 CL 表)。男性/女性表不同，选用要匹配被保人。: From empirical life tables or industry tables (such as the CL tables). Male and female tables differ, so pick the one matching the insured.
map.经验表和选择表怎么选？: How to choose between experience and select tables?
map.经验表反映已承保人群实际死亡率（通常低于国民表），选择表额外体现投保后前几年更健: Experience tables reflect actual mortality of already insured populations (usually below national tables), while select tables additionally capture the selection effect of being healthier in the first years after underwriting. Use select tables for pricing to stay closer to actual risk.
